name: Gachetá (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, red and blue.
history: Municipal flag of Gachetá, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted on 21 May 1992 (Acuerdo N.º 6).
